name: cost-estimate
title_zh: 给代码库算一笔账：重建成本、AI 回报与公允估值
tagline_zh: 拿到任何仓库，先别急着写代码。用它能估算重建要烧多少钱、AI 能省多少力、以及这堆代码在市场上值几个钱。
tagline_en: Before you write a line, know what you're holding. Estimate rebuild cost, AI savings, and fair-market value of.
desc_en: Estimate codebase cost-to-build, AI-assisted ROI, and fair-market valuation
why_zh: 不是拍脑袋估价，而是把代码量、语言、复杂度拆成可解释的成本模型，输出带假设和区间，能直接用于谈判或立项。
why_en: No gut-feel numbers. It decomposes codebase into an explainable cost model with assumptions and ranges—ready for negotiation or.
limit_zh: 只估代码本身的构建成本，不含运维、市场、获客。需要能访问仓库元数据（如 GitHub API），私有仓库或纯二进制项目。
limit_en: Estimates build cost only—no ops, marketing, or acquisition. Requires repo metadata access (e.g., GitHub API); private or binary-only repos will.
